ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AD$ is the altitude on side $BC$, $CE$ is the median on side $AB$, $G$ is the midpoint of $EC$, connecting $DG$, $CD = AE$, $AD = 6$, and $BD = 8$. Find the length of $CD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AD$ is the altitude from $A$ to side $BC$, and $AD=6$, \\
$BD=8$, \\
therefore $\angle ADB=90^\circ$, and $AB=\sqrt{AD^{2}+BD^{2}}=\sqrt{6^{2}+8^{2}}=10$, \\
since $CE$ is the median to side $AB$, \\
therefore $BE=AE=\frac{1}{2}AB=5$, \\
since $CD=AE$, \\
therefore $CD=\boxed{5}$
